title: Mini MURDLE — Password Reset
subtitle: Mini mode: 3 suspects, 3 weapons, 3 locations
storyHtml:
A new analyst reported a suspicious login from a secure workstation just as a payroll export changed. Three suspects were in the room, each with a distinct method and location.

  • Only one person was the culprit.
  • Each suspect is tied to exactly one weapon and one location.
  • Solve your notebook one deduction at a time.

Use clues to eliminate possibilities, then confirm your final accusation.

clues.text: The suspect was last seen entering from the rooftop side entrance.
A second witness says Bea carried the ledger.
A server log confirms the flask was found beside Cora's desk.
Cora was not at the Archive when the breach happened.
Bea was never seen carrying the Scalpel.
